title: Flooring Requirement Contract Solicitation
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR COMBAT COMMAND > FA4659  319 CONS PK

description:
The 319th Contracting Squadron, Grand Forks AFB, North Dakota, is issuing this Solicitation as a means to Request for Quotes (RFQ) to identify parties to award a Firm-Fixed-Price Requirements Contract for the following:  

 The work under this project consists of providing all material, equipment, and labor necessary for maintaining flooring/carpeting and other services necessary to perform Grand Forks Air Force Flooring work for GFAFB in accordance with the attached specifications. The work may include, but is not limited to, the following: Verification of Dimensions, Flooring Removal, Patch flooring, Surface Preparation, Installation, Disposal of Debris, and Furnishing Flooring as described in the attached documents. 

 Quotes are due by  2 December 2026 at 3:00PM CST  and shall be submitted electronically to SSgt Asante Nieves, Contract Specialist at  asante.nieves@us.af.mil  or Ms. Monique Padilla, Contracting Officer at  monique.padilla.3@us.af.mil.  Quoters must review all solicitation attachments for complete performance requirements. If proposal file size exceeds email limits, the offeror must request a DoD SAFE link from the POCs in advance of the due date. 

 The current applicable wage determination is included and any updates prior to award or task order issuance will apply. 

 All solicitation updates will be posted to SAM.gov.
